annotation.speech2: Two copies of the same tree diagram side by side. Each has w equals f of x y at the top, the intermediate variables x and y below it, and the two independent variables r and s at the bottom. In the left copy the branches leading down to r are highlighted in orange and the branches to s are faint grey; in the right copy the branches leading to s are highlighted in blue instead. Under each tree is the corresponding chain rule formula.
In the left tree, the highlighted branches are those running from w through x and through y down to r, giving the formula for the partial derivative of w with respect to r.
In the right tree, the highlighted branches run down to s instead, giving the formula for the partial derivative of w with respect to s.
The faint grey branches are the ones not used for this particular derivative.
